evidence_basis: Official toxic-substance appendix independently records the named two-component mixture and its mixture CAS.
verification_note: 2023-1-1162 is explicitly listed as the mixture of dichlorodimethylstannane (753-73-1) and trichloromethylstannane (993-16-8), mixture CAS 78643-41-1. It is not described as a reaction mixture/product and is suitable for the NAMED_MIXTURE benchmark.
